login.subtitle: Sign in to continue
login.apiKeySubtitle: Enter the API key to continue
login.apiKeyHelp: No username and password are set, so Shrinkerr signs you in with its API key. You'll find it in your NZBGet or SABnzbd script settings.

banner.tmdbMissing: No TMDB API key configured — titles can't be matched to metadata (native language, posters). Add a free key in Settings → Integrations → Metadata APIs.
banner.demo: Demo — a made-up library with a made-up history. Look around; changes are turned off.

authSetup.title: Set up sign-in
authSetup.intro: Shrinkerr now asks everyone to sign in: anyone who can open it can change its settings and delete files. Choose how.

forms.title: Sign-in page
forms.help: A username and password, on Shrinkerr's sign-in page.

external.title: External (reverse proxy)
external.help: Your reverse proxy (Authelia, Authentik, …) signs people in, so Shrinkerr asks nobody. Only if Shrinkerr can't be reached except through the proxy.

authSetup.localHelp: Local addresses: your home network (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 172.16–31.x.x). Requests passed on by something on the server (a reverse proxy, Tailscale) always sign in.
authSetup.apiKeys: Download clients, Sonarr, Radarr and remote workers keep using the API key.
